MPs say ministers 'failed to make the case' for Heathrow third runway

The Commons transport committee said on Thursday that ministers have "failed to make the case" for a third runway at Heathrow. Its report says the detailed policy papers laid out by the government show expansion of the London airport would fall short of pledges on the economy and climate.

Reported by The Guardian; Financial Times.
